market_summary: All major assets are currently consolidating after strong directional moves during the New York session. Gold and FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) remain in heavy downtrends below VWAP/EMA50 but are stretched near Session Lows and lower ATR bands with contracting volume. US100 and BTCUSD demonstrate strong overall uptrends above VWAP/VAH, but both face immediate overhead resistance at Session Highs and GEX Call Walls with negative CVD divergence on BTC. Standing aside on all instruments until pullbacks or clean retests materialize.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (4028.54) and below POC (4043.68). CVD -2.92 is BEARISH with a negative slope (-0.52), agreeing with downward pressure. SESSION is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is well below VWAP (4035.40) and EMA50 (4024.30), pressing into the lower ATR band (3994.65). Low volume on recent candles, but GEX is in NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING regime below Gamma Flip (3996.46) with price breaking support. However, price is severely overextended near lower ATR and testing Session Low (3987.10), making immediate short entries risky without a pull-back retest.
